ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Unconstrained Delegation Discovery Via Get-ADComputer - ScriptBlock
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of the "Get-ADComputer" cmdlet in order to identify systems which are configured for unconstrained delegation. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Properties*TrustedForDelegation.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Properties*TrustedToAuthForDelegation.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Properties*msDS\\-AllowedToDelegateTo.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Properties*PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-LDAPFilter*\\(userAccountControl\\:1\\\.2\\\.840\\\.113556\\\.1\\\.4\\\.803\\:\\=524288\\).*"))
